description: A script for validating npm release packages, including version parsing, metadata checks, tarball content validation, and release process logic.

methods.name: normalizeRepoUrl
methods.description: Normalizes repository URL strings by trimming and removing prefixes/suffixes.

methods.name: parseReleaseVersion
methods.description: Parses a version string into a structured release version object.

methods.name: resolveNpmPublishPlan
methods.description: Determines the npm publish plan based on version and requested tags.

methods.name: resolveNpmDistTagMirrorAuth
methods.description: Determines authentication info for npm dist tags.

methods.name: shouldSkipPackedTarballValidation
methods.description: Checks environment variable to decide whether to skip tarball validation.

methods.name: parseReleaseTagVersion
methods.description: Parses a release tag string into structured data.

methods.name: collectReleasePackageMetadataErrors
methods.description: Validates package.json fields and returns errors.

methods.name: collectReleaseTagErrors
methods.description: Validates release tags and version consistency.

methods.name: resolveNpmCommandInvocation
methods.description: Resolves the command and arguments to invoke npm.

methods.name: collectControlUiPackErrors
methods.description: Checks for required UI assets in package contents.

methods.name: collectForbiddenPackedPathErrors
methods.description: Detects forbidden paths in package tarball.
